capabilities: Sync Markdown checkbox tasks and project notes to Feishu task lists
Complete or reopen tasks from either side with two-way state updates
Configure sync scope by project folder, extra folders, tags, and daily notes
Resolve conflicting edits and recover unconfirmed task associations
Export and import a transfer package to move sync settings between devices
extras: The plugin interface is currently Chinese-only. It is not in the community plugin directory: users must manually download main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css from GitHub releases, and the manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian desktop 1.7.2 or later; automatic sync should run on only one device per vault.
intentEvidence: These rename steps apply to JH Wang's 飞书任务联动 releases 1.3.x–1.4.x.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep its Markdown tasks in step with Feishu task lists, so completions made on one side go unnoticed on the other.
